change: Public repository downloads recover once after rejected GitHub authentication, without changing saved credentials or service configuration.

adopted.native: Bundle Git reads, runtime subprocesses and wrapped preparation failures use child-only anonymous retry with original arguments and remaining deadline. Mutation receipts retain only a retry flag and sanitized classification.
adopted.smartTools: Installed MCP owner bounds a single anonymous Git/uv read retry; remote writes are not eligible.
adopted.workspace: Clone/download helper preserves file descriptors, destination and original deadline while removing child-only credential injection for the one retry.
adopted.feedback: Repository metadata uses bounded fixed-origin anonymous HTTPS first; existing authenticated CLI access remains available for private reads. Account queries and remote writes stay authenticated.
adopted.sourceTracking: Distribution source verification retries rejected GitHub ls-remote once, retaining exact source/ref and deadline. Explicit source overrides are still protected.

equivalents.applicationAndTerminalRelease: Signed HTTPS channels and digest-verified artifacts are fetched without GitHub credentials. They already avoid the GitHub REST/account dependency.
equivalents.installation: Immutable signed installation and archive paths retain exact identity/integrity checks. Their configured Git source verification uses the updated source resolver. There is no legacy uv tool install bootstrap in this distribution.
equivalents.repair: Native runtime repair inherits the updated dependency download helper while preserving original generation and exact activation/rollback boundaries. Legacy whole-app reset is not copied into the owner-separated architecture.

limits: Source and focused installed-native checks only; final candidate archive, DTU deployment and external-account acceptance are separate evidence.
No architecture merge, production publication or repository rename.
